name: Sunky.MPEG
title: The Silly One
bio: A completely harmless, crudely drawn parody entity who accidentally stumbled into the executioner lineup. Armed with an infinite supply of milk and cereal, this lighthearted little guy bypasses the horror entirely—wishing only to dance and have fun with his pals, WARNING: DO NOT SPILL HIS MILK AND CEREAL WHATEVER YOU DO-
